title: Level 1 Comprehensive Assessment Exam
description: Official Level 1 examination evaluating reading comprehension, grammar accuracy, vocabulary usage, sentence structure, and analytical writing across all 8 supported question types.
instructions: Read every question carefully before selecting or entering your answer. You may flag questions to revisit before submitting. The exam will automatically submit when the countdown timer expires.

questions.text: Choose the correct form of the verb to complete the sentence: 'Neither the teacher nor the students _____ aware of the schedule change yesterday.'
questions.explanation: With 'neither...nor', the verb agrees with the closer subject ('students', plural) in the past tense ('yesterday' -> 'were').

questions.text: Which of the following sentences are written in the PASSIVE voice? (Select all that apply)

options.text: The new examination portal was designed by the engineering team.
Students completed their assignments before the deadline.
All exam results are calculated automatically by the backend.
The instructor reviewed the essay submissions carefully.

questions.explanation: Sentences A ('was designed') and C ('are calculated') use the passive structure (be + past participle).

questions.text: A dependent (subordinate) clause can stand alone as a complete grammatical sentence.
questions.explanation: A dependent clause cannot stand alone as a sentence; it must be connected to an independent clause.

questions.text: Enter the comparative form of the adjective 'good':
questions.explanation: 'Good' is an irregular adjective whose comparative form is 'better' and superlative form is 'best'.

questions.text: Fill in the missing prepositions: She is highly proficient _____ academic writing and always submits her work _____ time.
questions.explanation: The adjective 'proficient' collocates with 'in' (or 'at'), and 'on time' means punctual/before the deadline.

questions.text: Match each sentence type on the left with its corresponding example on the right:

pairs.right: The library opens at eight o'clock every morning.
Have you completed all the assigned practice tasks?
Please review your answers carefully before clicking submit.

correct_answer.P1: The library opens at eight o'clock every morning.
correct_answer.P2: Have you completed all the assigned practice tasks?
correct_answer.P3: Please review your answers carefully before clicking submit.

questions.explanation: Declarative sentences state facts, interrogative sentences ask questions, and imperative sentences issue instructions or requests.

questions.text: Order the stages of the academic writing process from first (top) to last (bottom):
questions.explanation: Effective writing progresses from planning/outlining to drafting, structural revision, and final proofreading.

questions.text: Write a well-structured short essay (120–180 words) discussing the benefits of continuous assessment (tasks and quizzes) compared to relying solely on a single final examination.
questions.correct_answer: Grading Rubric: Thesis statement & introduction (5 pts), comparison of continuous tasks vs single exam with supporting points (10 pts), grammar, vocabulary & cohesion (5 pts).
questions.explanation: Evaluated by the instructor based on analytical depth, organization, and language accuracy.
